analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it bumps 'Last updated' to 2026-10-21 (head line 3) and adds a paragraph at head lines 253-259. That paragraph says the SSD prefix-cache stage runs before engine.submit and off the engine queue, and that a provider-staged complete-checkpoint import creates destinations already available from host bytes without evaluating or fencing them, so staging does not wait for the engine's evalLock. No code, key handling, authorization, encryption, or wire behavior changes in this diff, so no finding. Relevant threat: T-041 (encrypted SSD prefix cache, TB-007, A-001). The doc describes a source change in CompleteCheckpointTransfer.swift that is not in this batch. I could not verify that behavior or its effect on T-041 mitigations. The mitigations are AES-GCM at rest, HMAC lookup tags, salt scoping, the staging reservation release paths (SSDPrefixCache.endAdoption/completeStaging) and decrypted host Data lifetime. Whether staged plaintext host buffers are bounded and released is unverified. If the corresponding source change alters staging, reservations or plaintext buffer lifetime, the T-041 detection_hint scope applies and the source-level review should cover it. Other unit contents (MiMo, calibration, deadline text) are unchanged context.
